tools.name: create_feed
tools.description: Creates a subscription calendar from user-reviewed structured events and optionally activates it. Intended for an explicit request to save a schedule. The caller supplies the events; source-document extraction and automatic monitoring are not performed. Existing account feed and creation allowances

tools.description: Lists the connected account’s feeds, management links and shared active-feed allowance for a requested calendar lookup.
